static_traits.name: Chen Jie
static_traits.family_status: Parents are in their 80s, has 8 brothers; close relationships with her brothers, but interactions are affected due to suspicion of praise
static_traits.social_status: Has good family support (close with brothers, able to discuss various topics), but finds it hard to directly share doubts about their intentions
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical health problems; has not yet received psychological counseling or treatment; no similar psychological problems before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to give specific examples; able to identify and describe automatic thoughts; highly cooperative, positive attitude; trying to handle doubts through rationalization

basic_info.main_problem: I persistently doubt the sincerity of the positive interactions and praise I receive from family, especially at family gatherings or when interacting with my brothers; this causes insecurity and distrust, in turn making family relationships tense.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize that my inability to trust my family's positive feedback is straining our relationship and causing emotional distress, so I seek counseling.
growth_experiences: Grew up in adolescence in a large family with 8 brothers, with attention and emotional care being divided, often feeling neglected; from this gradually formed a suspicion of the sincerity of positive feedback, a pattern that continued from puberty into adulthood and affects family interaction to this day.

core_beliefs: I am not worthy of being sincerely recognized

special_situations.event: At a family dinner last week, the brother praised her cooking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Family members' praise is usually just politeness rather than sincerity; if I accept it easily I will be hurt by the 'false affection'
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Staying restrained and distant, responding flatly or withdrawing for self-protection, avoiding showing delight
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He is just being polite; he does not really like my cooking.

special_situations.event: Her brother tells her she is the 'favorite'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: When others say things like 'favorite', they often say them to other people too; it cannot be taken seriously
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using rational inference and self-questioning to lower expectations, not discussing feelings deeply with them
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They say this to other people too; I should not believe it.

special_situations.event: At family gatherings, siblings praise her achievements or looks
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: When praise appears, it is more likely out of politeness rather than true feelings
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing communication, avoiding eye contact, turning to silence to lower discomfort
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are not sincere; they are just brushing me off.

special_situations.event: When interacting with family, thinks of the divided attention in the large family in the past
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: In such a family structure, genuine appreciation rarely appears; I had better not expect it
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Adopts a preset defensive attitude, filtering information through suspicion to avoid emotional investment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: In our family, compliments are rarely sincere.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be sincerely seen, recognized, and cherished by family
core_conflict.fear: Afraid one's vulnerability will be exploited or brushed off, worried that after accepting praise one will meet disappointment and neglect
defense_goal: Ensuring safety by staying skeptical and distant, lowering expectations to avoid getting hurt

object_relations.self_representation: A person easily overlooked, needing cautious self-protection
object_relations.object_representation: Polite but insincere family members who may disappoint

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or family suggests open communication, or positively evaluates her
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously regards positive feedback as possibly 'perfunctory', believing that in-depth communication will expose vulnerability and bring disappointment
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use a calm, analytical tone, emphasizing evidence and logic, trying not to touch on subjective feelings and the vulnerable side.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When receiving praise or positive interaction at family gatherings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting the other's positive behavior as insincere surface politeness
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintains politeness but responds briefly, reduces eye contact and self-disclosure, and quickly ends topics in a neutral tone.

manifestations: Finding it hard to accept praise at family gatherings, developing distrust and estrangement
Worrying that directly expressing doubts will be misunderstood or offend, choosing not to mention true feelings
outcomes: Worsening relationship tension and sense of distance

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Immediately self-doubts the sincerity of praise after receiving it
Not daring to speak for fear that expressing doubts will offend family

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Displacing the topic or giving a politely brief reply when complimented, avoiding deeper exchange
Substitutes direct experiencing and expressing feelings with 'rational analysis'

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Projecting one's doubt onto the other as 'not genuine' / 'just polite'
Interprets praise as perfunctory to reduce exposure of own vulnerability

positive_force: Close relationships with brothers; stable family support exists
Willing to seek help and change (actively seeks counseling, positive attitude)
Able to identify and name negative automatic thoughts, with a basis for cognitive reappraisal
negative_force: Long-term skepticism about the sincerity of praise, forming a distrustful cognitive framework
The narrative of 'divided attention' from a large family continues to affect self-worth and expectations
Common cognitive biases: negating the positive, mind reading, overgeneralization
Tending toward withdrawal and estrangement in interactions, further reinforcing relationship tension and the sense of isolation

target_behavior.behavior: Strong doubt with social withdrawal when receiving praise at family gatherings or when interacting with brothers
antecedent: Family gatherings or family interaction scenarios
Siblings' positive evaluations and praise of achievements, appearance, or behavior
target_behavior.core_reason: Growing up in a large family where attention and emotional care were divided, forming the deep belief that 'praise is not genuine' and a self-protection tendency
target_behavior.function: Escapes possible disappointment and being hurt, maintaining psychological safety and emotional control
target_behavior.consequence: Distrust and insecurity arise, relationship tension, declining interaction quality, increasing emotional distress
